## Purpose

Signal in Client telemetry: The human-readable identifier or title of this record; check the collection-specific label before choosing it. It is not an authentication credential.

## Constraints and permissions

This collection is read-only in the model; inspect this field in its table/details instead of editing it. The declared input is text; the exact submit-time checks remain with the renderer and current state. This help does not invent additional numeric limits or identity rules. Use only synthetic non-secret data.

## Expected result

Inspect the value in the `#/telemetry` table/details or an allowed dialog. A successful preview edit changes browser-local demonstration state only; it does not charge, authenticate, send a ticket, move a key, dispatch a device or execute a service command.

## Recovery

Cancel the dialog to keep the preceding record. If a field or permission error appears, correct the intended field/context and review again instead of widening role/scope. Read-only, loading, empty or error presentations are not proof that a real backend action succeeded. Use the operations and incident response guide for the complete safe journey.
